starters.name: Start Blank
starters.summary: A minimal runnable plugin shell with no example domain or product requirements.
starters.outcome: Best when your idea does not fit an existing pattern.

Native settings surface and host-friendly design tokens
No example entities, source recipes or PRDs
implementation: Your domain model, pages and business behavior
Native acceptance and release qualification

starters.name: Command Utility

starters.outcome: Start here for a focused utility rather than a large workspace.
includes: Utility workbench with text input and preview
Native command, ribbon and settings entry points
Local clear-input effect and scoped PRD acceptance TODOs
implementation: Bind the active editor or selection through host APIs
Implement the transformation and preserve undo history

starters.name: Quick Capture
starters.summary: Collect ideas through a focused capture dialog and a reviewable inbox.
starters.outcome: Adapt for notes, bookmarks, meeting intake or a personal inbox.

implementation: Validate and persist notes atomically
Choose append/create behavior and protect filenames

starters.name: Tasks & Projects

starters.outcome: Adapt into a reading list, research library, asset register or simple CRM.

Record/category models and a relationship
Typed fields, source port and fixture scenarios
implementation: Implement note creation and metadata changes
Define domain validation and attachment policy

starters.name: Daily Journal

starters.outcome: Adapt for a home view, reading dashboard or project health overview.

starters.name: Note Inspector

implementation: Bind active-note changes and lifecycle cleanup
